runtimeNotes: GameData.FindPath uses unweighted BFS, not polyline distance. Runtime currently treats every catalog edge as bidirectional, regardless of source bidirectional.
CityRouteGeometry.Points = locked arrival(from) + ordered waypoints + locked arrival(to), reversed for reverse traversal.
CityMapPaths dots sample the same geometry; covered walkway dot suppression does not alter movement.
Portals are event-based city transitions, not city walking edges. No Unity import/apply is included.
